title: Invariant Guided PINN for Fluid Flow Computation
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often become difficult to optimize for incompressible flow problems with large spatial domains, multiscale stresses, or long-time invariant dynamics. We propose an invariant-guided PINN (IG-PINN) framework that uses partitioned training as a conservative preconditioning stage rather than as the final piecewise representation.
